title: Movement Priority
description: Forces movement keys to take priority over conflicting keybinds while in-game, while still letting those keybinds work normally inside GUIs.
body:
### Movement Priority
A simple client-side mod that makes movement keys take priority over any conflicting keybinds while you're in-game. If you have another keybind (such as chat) set to the same key as a movement key, this mod ensures movement always wins outside of GUIs. Inside GUIs like crafting tables and inventories, the conflicting keybind fires normally as expected. Most notably used to double bind a movement key to the chat key in order to search craft with a movement key.
